comparison.objective: Load an IV-set fitment and safety clamp into a pump; the candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop, then tests it.
comparison.physical_skill: Keyed seating of two parts joined by soft tubing versus concentric driver-and-wrench countertorque that preserves a screw setting.
comparison.success_condition: Fitment and clamp seated without twist or stretch, then released; candidate requires a locked 90° opening retained through three cycles with tools clear.
comparison.reason: Soft-tube-guided insertion and clamp seating do not test adjustable-stop preservation under jam-nut reaction or post-lock cycling.
